en.headline: Working Group to launch four new tourist hotspot projects from fourth quarter
en.dek: The initiatives cover industrial brand tours including KMB depots, a miniature city exhibition at The Peak, temple cultural routes and seasonal Yuen Long experiences.
body: The Working Group on Developing Tourist Hotspots, led by Deputy Chief Secretary Cheuk Wing-hing, announced on Friday that it would gradually roll out four new projects from the fourth quarter to offer more Hong Kong-characteristic tourism experiences.

The second phase of Hong Kong industrial brand tourism will add visits to Kowloon Motor Bus depots, the MTR ‘Encounter·Station’ railway exhibition and the Beijing Tong Ren Tang Hong Kong production and research base. Visitors will tour the facilities in organised groups arranged through the Hong Kong Tourism Board’s travel agent coordination.

Madame Tussauds will relaunch a Hong Kong miniature city exhibition at Peak Tower from the fourth quarter, adding new miniature artworks depicting landmarks, local customs and everyday life. The Chinese Temples Committee is enhancing digital promotion at its temples with QR codes and an app, while the Government will study routes linking temples with historic buildings.

The Yuen Long District Office will partner with community groups on a ‘Yuen Long Good Times’ programme promoting seasonal experiences such as the Tin Hau Festival parade and autumn-winter nature visits, with maps, a website and information boards to be introduced in phases from the fourth quarter to early next year.

zh.headline: 發展旅遊熱點工作組第四季起推四個新項目
zh.dek: 項目涵蓋九巴車廠及鐵路展等工業品牌遊、山頂微型城市展、廟宇文化深度遊及「元朗好時節」。
body: 由政務司副司長卓永興領導的發展旅遊熱點工作組周五公布，將於今年第四季起逐步推出下一階段四個項目，為旅客提供更多具香港特色的多元化旅遊體驗。
第二階段香港工業品牌旅遊新增九龍巴士車廠、港鐵「載遇‧站見」鐵路展及北京同仁堂香港生產研發基地等。旅客可透過「團進團出」形式參觀，由香港旅遊業議會統籌預約，預計第四季起陸續開放。
香港杜莎夫人蠟像館將於第四季起在山頂凌霄閣重塑香港微型城市展，加入全新微型藝術展品，呈現地標、地道習俗及生活特色。華人廟宇委員會加強直轄廟宇數碼化，增設二維碼及應用程式，政府亦會研究以廟宇為核心串連歷史建築的深度遊路線。
元朗民政事務處將與地區團體合作推出「元朗好時節」，鼓勵按季節探索地區特色，如天后誕會景巡遊及秋冬自然生態，並製作旅遊地圖、主題網站及資訊牌，預計第四季至明年初分階段推出。
